fields.value: Model runs - Post-fire regeneration traits of understorey shrub species modulate successional responses to high severity fire in Mediterranean pine forests

dsDescriptionValue.value: This data set contains the results of the model runs that gave origin to the paper "Post-fire regeneration traits of understorey shrub species modulate successional responses to high severity fire in Mediterranean pine forests" published in the journal Ecosystems.

topicClassValue.value: Other Environmental Sciences Not Elsewhere Classified

fields.value:
This entry is a three thousand, six hundred and eighteen-file data package totaling 65.6 MB, containing files in .m and .mat formats.

If you use this dataset, please cite: Vasques, Ana; Baudena, Mara; Ramón Vallejo, V.; Kéfi, Sonia; Bautista, Susana; Santana, Victor M.; et al. (2022). Model runs - Post-fire regeneration traits of understorey shrub species modulate successional responses to high severity fire in Mediterranean pine forests. Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR). Dataset. https://doi.org/10.25397/eur.19131320
